From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Availability anchors for 30-minute product preview and engineering escort

Hi Maya / Liam —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery: Stellaris is focused on reducing per-query latency for your document ingestion pipeline while keeping tight controls on cost and data separation. Next step I suggested on the call was a short 30-minute product preview (intro + one infra slide) that brings your engineering and procurement folks up to speed.

To make calendar alignment painless, can you pick one of the two "availability anchors" below? These are intentionally narrow so we can lock a slot quickly and then send a calendar invite. If neither works, tell me two 30-minute windows that do.

Proposed anchors (30 minutes):
- Anchor A: Tue Jul 20, 2026 — 10:00–10:30 AM PT (Ben, Marissa, Product + quick infra notes)
- Anchor B: Wed Jul 21, 2026 — 09:00–09:30 AM PT (same agenda)

Who we'd like on the call from your side:
- Engineering/Platform owner (infra/ops)
- One product stakeholder (PM or data lead)
- Optional: procurement or vendor management for any initial questions on licensing/SLAs

I've attached a one‑page discovery summary and a starter mutual action plan to help scope the session.

Attachments: [Attachment: discovery-notes.pdf (PDF)], [Attachment: mutual-action-plan.csv (CSV)]

If you confirm Anchor A or B I will:
1) Send calendar invite with dial-in + brief agenda;
2) Add Marissa (customer success) for onboarding next steps;
3) Share a short pre-read (1 pager) so we can spend the 30 minutes on live demo + infra Qs.

Thanks — appreciate a quick preference so we can lock.

Best,

Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0198

--
